notes.title: NEW Release VR game on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello. We are CSI Studio.

We are so happy to introduce the NEW VR PvP game called "RealShots"
Service for "Real Shots" will begin on January 24th, 2018
The current version is focused on PVP play and the contents of the game we provide are as follows.

1. Lobby, you can check the rankings, set the character and gun, and select 
    the mode to play the game.
2. Real-time online game, providing quick matching and custom matching. 
    Custom matching is a game method that can be played by directly asking
    the user who knows nickname.     
3. We provide seasonal ranking of the week by winning or losing PVP.  
    You can earn rewards by ranking higher.   
4. You can play with 1vs1 and 2 vs 2 battle in 5 maps in the game.
5. 6 characters are available.
6. There are 27 different kinds of guns available. (Assault rifles, sniper rifles, 
    machine guns, shotguns), which can be updated continuously.     
7. Characters and Guns can be purchased at the store with in-game money.   

We aim to create a fun Gun combat VR game and think the solo play and storyline provides fantastic growth potential.

Enjoy the game and any feedback will be greatly appreciated.

Thank You.
CSI Studios. CEO Jack Shin.
